text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув gives a splendid performance
at the
Oka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having faced off against powerful
opponents, the
thought of the even
more difficult races ahead
lights a fire of
determination within Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to do even better at the
Japanese Oaks,
Эйр Грув keeps up the
pace as she moves ever
forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
